title: ENDEX — Badge Cloning & Physical-Cyber Convergence

fields.resolution: ENDEX. The PACS server logs flash red one final time, then go dark. The rogue AP in Electrical Room B is confirmed offline. All network access is restored to baseline. The incident is closed. This concludes the exercise.
finalState: The rogue AP in Electrical Room B has been isolated and disabled.
The 125 kHz legacy readers remain in place but are flagged for replacement.
The IT team has confirmed that no external actor accessed the network via the rogue device.
The FBI has closed its involvement, citing successful containment and attribution to Viktor Sorin.
The airport's badge system remains operational, though with enhanced audit controls.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Put down your phones and radios. We will take ten minutes, then start the hot wash.
fields.hotWashMethod: 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well, three things that broke
hotWashQuestions: When did you confirm this was a clone and not a glitch? What evidence convinced you?
The Wednesday V-1 double-tap — did you spot it? What does that tell you about log analysis?
Twelve minutes in Electrical Room B. How do you prevent physical access to network infrastructure?
Legacy readers: $25 to clone a badge. What's the cost of replacing 12 readers vs. the cost of this incident?
Option A/B/C — what did you choose and why? What would the FBI have recommended?
fields.facilitatorNote: Ensure all teams submit final decisions on Option A/B/C. Collect the PACS Forensic Evidence Packet and return to IT lead.
fields.scenarioTitle: Carbon Copy — Scenario 5: Badge Cloning & Physical-Cyber Convergence

instructorNote: This inject closes the exercise. The hot wash must focus on systemic failures, not individual errors. Emphasize that the rogue AP was not used — but the threat was real and the response had to be deliberate.

citations.quote: - All Staff: RUN. HIDE. FIGHT.; call 911 or ACC with shooter location/description when safe. - LEO/Security: assume IC; contact teams; establish cold/warm/hot zones; declare scene secure for EMS. - Op
